Package com.helix.core.ml

Class OnnxFeatureExtractor

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.ml.OnnxFeatureExtractor
public class OnnxFeatureExtractor extends Object
Extracts and transforms runtime execution context features into native ONNX tensor buffers.

Validates schema alignment against OnnxModelDescriptor.inputFeatures(), safely coerces mixed numeric and boolean types into single-precision float representations, and constructs zero-copy 2D arrays ready for OnnxTensor allocation.
